# PhishDeep

PhishDeep is a cybersecurity intelligence platform designed to detect phishing, malware, and cyber threats on URLs and APK files. It provides actionable visual forensic evidence.

## Features
- URL Scanning and Phishing Detection
- APK Malware Analysis
- Visual Forensic Reports
- Cyber Threat Intelligence

## Target Audience
Indonesian internet users, cybersecurity professionals, and enterprises.

## Tech Stack
Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Python, Puppeteer.
